div.div:
1. Thresholds are versioned data in DynamoDB, never hardcoded on the nodes; a crop alert starts the drone confirmation (ADR-002).
2. One SMS and push per episode opening or closure; reminders are push only.
3. Only the dispatcher reads the personal table (phone, push endpoint); the threshold function reads no personal data.
4. Solid = live path; dashed = acknowledgement, async check or delivery receipt.
